metadata.case_name: CHAU WING CHUEN v. JENKINS ROY IAN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: MRI scanning of cervical spine showed loss of the normal cervical lordosis and minimal broad-based posterior disc bulges at C4/5 and C5/6 levels with slight indentation of the thecal sac.
source: MRI scanning of cervical spine showed loss of the normal cervical lordosis and minimal broad-based posterior disc bulges at C4/5 and C5/6 levels with slight indentation of the thecal sac.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

injuries.description: the plaintiff probably had a neck sprain with soft tissue involvement.
source: the plaintiff probably had a neck sprain with soft tissue involvement.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine, unspecified

injuries.description: MRI scan was done of the right shoulder too and that revealed mild focal thickening with increased signals of his right subscapularis tendon near its insertion site at less tuberosity. There was no complete tendon disruption but the features were suspected of partial tear.
source: MRI scan was done of the right shoulder too and that revealed mild focal thickening with increased signals of his right subscapularis tendon near its insertion site at less tuberosity. There was no complete tendon disruption but the features were suspected of partial tear.
the doctor agreed that there was an element of right supraspinatus tendinitis and partial subscapular tear
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

injuries.description: the plaintiff was still affected by the left wrist scapho-lunate ligament injury when the Accident occurred.
source: the plaintiff was still affected by the left wrist scapho-lunate ligament injury when the Accident occurred.
residual left wrist pain, weakness and numbness of the plaintiff was a pre-existing condition.

injuries.description: the report of DOT of TMH referred to ... symptoms and signs of left lateral epicondylitis when the plaintiff was seen on 10 September 2015
source: the report of DOT of TMH referred to progressive improvement in the three regions of complaint of the plaintiff. It also recorded the complaint of symptoms and signs of left lateral epicondylitis when the plaintiff was seen on 10 September 2015, as well as the doctors assessment on 10 March 2016 that the symptoms of the neck, shoulder and back had become mild and static.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of other extensor muscle, fascia or tendon at forearm level

manifestations.description: persistent stretching pain and pin-prick sensation at posterior neck and occiput, more on the right side
on and off paraesthesia of right upper limb, from shoulder to elbow
mild weakness in the right upper limb
tenderness at the subacromial region and limited range of motion of right shoulder due to pain
positive impingement sign of right shoulder
residual left wrist pain, weakness and numbness

treatments_received: ambulance to Accident & Emergency Department of Tuen Mun Hospital on 8 December 2013
in-patient treatment at Tsuen Wan Adventist Hospital from 10-12 December 2013
physiotherapy (25 sessions at TMH until 25 August 2014; additional 7 outpatient sessions from 12 January 2016 to 18 April 2016)
occupational therapy (35 sessions from 21 August 2014 to 2 March 2016)

losses.description: likely to be restricted to a desk job and precluded from undertaking manual work duties; reduction in work efficiency and handicap in the labour market
